card.name: Hospice and palliative care words
card.fires_on: The ending of 'hospice' (after Hosp) and of 'palliative' (after pall), mostly in cancer or end-of-life care text. It also fires weakly on 'sympt|omatic' in 'symptomatic treatment'.

modes.label: Hospice ending
modes.description: The 'ice' piece completing 'Hospice' in end-of-life care text.
modes.example: Hosp<<ice>> provides bereavement services for the patient

modes.label: Palliative ending
modes.description: The 'iative' piece completing 'palliative' before management, radiotherapy or therapy.
modes.example: For pall<<iative>> management of patients with recurrent or inoper

card.writes: It seems to push toward words that continue care-type terms such as 'therapy' and 'PACE', though the effect is not clear.
card.plain: It lights up when the word hospice or palliative is being completed in text about comfort care.
